title: Recipe
description: One recipe: what it makes, what it needs, and how to cook it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The dish's name, as a cook would say it.

slug.title: Short name
slug.description: Lower-case letters and digits joined by hyphens; names the card's file.

serves.title: Serves
serves.description: How many people the recipe feeds.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: Total time from start to table, in minutes.

tip.title: Tip
tip.description: One or two sentences of advice that makes the dish turn out well.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.description: Everything the recipe uses, in the order it is used.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: How much, with its unit, such as "200 g" or "2".

item.title: Item
item.description: What to buy, such as "plain flour".

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The method, one instruction per step, in order.

items.title: Step
items.description: One instruction, saying what to do with what.
